title: Chapter 436
text:
Are you trying to kill me?

The Lord of Runes hurriedly looked behind him. None of the guards stepped forward. The officials that usually sucked up to him all hid far away, not daring to show their faces.

The Lord of Runes panicked. He clenched his teeth and suddenly grabbed the statue. He took a few steps back and raised the statue in front of him. He took a rune sword from the guard and pointed the tip of the sword at the statue, yelling, "Don't be so stupid.

"Don't do anything stupid, or I'll destroy what you want!"

Han Xiao stood where he was and opened his arms, signaling the Lord of Runes to do whatever he wanted.

"Go ahead. If you can destroy it, I'll spare your life," Han Xiao said with a mocking tone.

This statue looked like it was made of wood, but it was not damaged even when it fell from space. How could it be damaged by a sword? The Lord of Runes was desperate and had lost his mind.

Bang!

A bloody hole appeared on the Lord of Runes' head. The old man's eyes were wide open, and the hatred in his eyes turned into confusion. He fell to the ground, and his life left his body.

The people of the City of Runes trembled. They had seen their ruler get killed with their own eyes. They had a complicated feeling, but they were not angry. Planet Secret Blue did not have a strong sense of home. The residents moved frequently, and the Lord of Runes had always been unpopular.

Han Xiao put away his gun and picked up the statue. After it was stained with blood, the statue that was already weirdly shaped looked even more evil.

"Let's go." Han Xiao raised his head and looked at the sky.

Just as the people were confused about his actions, the sound of an engine came from the sky. A spaceship quickly passed through the atmosphere and arrived a few hundred meters above Han Xiao's head. It shot out a blue beam and covered Han Xiao.

His body rose into the air and was sucked into the spaceship under everyone's gaze.

On the ground, the people of the City of Runes were shocked.

"Is this the tool that the aliens use to travel?"

"It looks like machinery. Is the technology of Iron Fire Castle the most accurate?"

Hu!

While the people were discussing, the spaceship turned around. The thrusters at the back shot out blue flames, and it broke through the sound barrier in the blink of an eye, disappearing into the sky.

…

The aliens left just like that, but the City of Runes and the other organizations on Planet Secret Blue could not recover from the shock.

After knowing what had happened to the Lord of Runes, the upper echelons of the other organizations were all terrified.

Thankfully, the aliens landed in the City of Runes, or else we would have been the ones to suffer.

When they received the news last night, these people were still urgently discussing how to deal with the aliens. Many of them wanted to send people to snatch the aliens from the City of Runes … In their opinion, the City of Runes would most likely succeed. At this time, the Pro-War Faction, which had been the most vocal last night, was so scared that they broke out in a cold sweat.

Han Xiao's arrival had only taken a little more than ten hours, but the impact he brought to Planet Secret Blue was so great that it deeply changed the worldview of everyone on the planet. The process of seeing an alien for the first time was not harmonious, and there was no in-depth communication, but Han Xiao's influence on them was equally profound.

After all the organizations were shocked by Han Xiao's strength, they started to yearn for him. The warriors who were exploring the path of individual cultivation treated Han Xiao as their goal. They studied his limited performance against the army over and over again as if they wanted to comprehend a way to become stronger from it.

After witnessing the strength of the Galaxy Mercenaries, the various organizations on Planet Secret Blue had different degrees of awakening. They felt that fighting each other was meaningless. Perhaps in the eyes of the aliens, it was similar to ants fighting. However, this gave rise to the desire for peace. Han Xiao's actions became the reason why the various organizations came to a consensus to stop fighting.

This incident was also recorded in the historical records of Planet Secret Blue. The scholars analyzed the impact of the aliens' arrival on society from many aspects.

At the same time, because they saw that the spaceship was made of machinery, the technology on Planet Secret Blue finally had a tendency to unify. The machinery technology of Iron Fire Castle became the 'truth' that the various organizations recognized. They felt that this was the direction of the future development of their civilization. Therefore, they stopped researching other technology systems and focused on technology. Under the pressure of the other organizations, Iron Fire Castle had no choice but to share all their technological knowledge.

Most of the people on Planet Secret Blue spontaneously became materialists, and the structure of their civilization was subtly changed.

Although Han Xiao was there to cause trouble, the consequences were very positive. Planet Secret Blue learned a lesson from their own recklessness and wrong decision, and they had a new concept of how strong the aliens were. They became very careful. Only when they really contacted a galactic civilization did the organizations on Planet Secret Blue rejoice. Luckily, the first person who came was a mercenary, giving them a chance. If they had offended a more advanced civilization when they did not know the immensity of heaven and earth, in the future … no, there would be no future.

These were all changes that happened after Han Technician left, but he did not care about them.

After collecting all the statues, Han Xiao did not inform Chen Xing immediately. Instead, he went to the nearest colony planet of a galactic civilization.

His goal was to buy some special consumables.

Things that could be used on the statues.

…

A few days later, the spaceship returned to the Rain Star System. After the Unification Day celebration, Chen Xing was still on tour in the New Phylen Alliance. When he received Han Xiao's call, he was shocked and extremely surprised.

It had only been a few days, and the other two missing statues had already been found?!

Oh my God, what efficiency!

He had been looking for things for years, and these mercenaries found them in a few days. They were indeed professionals. They were indeed different!

The spaceship docked at a colony planet of a member civilization of the New Phylen Alliance. Chen Xing was on tour in this city. Under the warm reception of his assistant, Han Xiao and the others met Chen Xing in the most luxurious suite of a high-end hotel.

"Hahaha, Black Star, you really gave me a big surprise. I didn't expect you to be able to find all the statues so quickly." Chen Xing was overjoyed, and his face was flushed red with excitement.

This time, Han Xiao had brought everyone with him. It was Herlous' first time seeing Chen Xing. He mumbled softly, "So beautiful. Are you a man or a woman?"

"I'm a man. I'm a natural beauty." Chen Xing had sharp senses, and his lips curled up.

Han Xiao coughed and said, "I've brought the items for you. We'll have plenty of time to talk later. I think it's best to carry out the sacred transaction first."

Chen Xing threw a seductive glance at him and smiled, "So impatient? Alright then, I'm very satisfied with your efficiency. I'll pay you twice the amount as a reward for the surprise you've given me."

"Twice? Doesn't that mean … "Sylvia counted with her fingers and opened her mouth wide." Two … two hundred thousand! "

"Calm down, don't act like you haven't seen the world." Han Xiao tapped her head with his finger. She was a celebrity, after all. She was rich. What was there to be surprised about?

The four statues were placed on the table. Chen Xing checked them, confirmed that there were no mistakes, and paid without hesitation.

[Find Statues] Completed.

Calculating Mission … Calculation complete.

Mission Rating: Unbelievable

You have received [Unbelievable] Level Bonus Reward: 120% EXP (1,320,000), 100,000 Enas, 1 Random Reward, and 1 Special Item.

You have received [Character Summon Card – Chen Xing]!

Character Summon Card – Chen Xing: [Looking Back with a Smile] – + 688 CHA. Duration: 15 seconds. Usage: 0/3

Looking at the effect introduction, Han Xiao could not help but fall silent.

Other than the word 'awesome', he could not think of any other adjectives.

"688 attribute points, and it just has to be Charm. Is this trying to make the enemy go into a nosebleed state? Is it going to make them die of handsomeness? If this was added to Intelligence, I'd f * cking go fight Grade A right now! "

The corners of Han Xiao's mouth twitched, and he felt extremely annoyed.

Look Back with a Smile? Smile your balls!

Charm had always been a support attribute. It was mainly used for trading discounts, enchantment-type skill bonuses, affinity with various creatures, taming beasts, gaining favorability with various characters, and so on. Almost no players would focus on Charm … Er, except for some female players. With such high Charm, theoretically, no player would add so many points. Han Xiao felt that this value had its own Charm. Just looking at him would make people want to use a Will Judgement.

So angry, why did it have to be Charm! What I have is more than enough!

Han Xiaoxin's heart was in turmoil. His face was tense on the surface, but no one could see it.

Including the bonus reward, he had received a total of 243 EXP and 20 Enas. The main thing was that the reward was really high. As expected of a celebrity, she was so generous. Han Xiaoxin's savings had finally exceeded the million mark.

This time, he had received an extremely high rating. However, because the difficulty of the mission was only Grade C, there were no Legendary Points or Medal of Honor rewards. He only had one Medal of Honor, which was the [Germinal Organization Buried] that he had received after destroying the Germinal Organization. Its effect was to increase all attributes by 3%, effective immediately. If he collected three of them, he could exchange them for a special achievement badge that gave him + 12%.

However, the [Unbelievable] rating would definitely give him a random reward. That was the key.

Han Xiao's eyes were firm. He pulled Herlous over, his hands moving all over his body, from his head to his shoulders.

"What are you trying to do?" Herlous felt disgusted and quickly jumped away.

"To rub off on your luck." Han Xiao rubbed his hands. He knew exactly how bad his luck was. Old Herlous was a main character with a Lucky Halo above his head. At this time, he was willing to believe in a wave of metaphysics.

Taking a deep breath, the Han Technician's face was solemn. With a serious expression, he slowly chose to confirm.

Randomizing …

Randomization complete.

The type of reward you have received this time is: [Talent/Talent]

"F * ck you!"
